title: Joint surjectivity of families on algebraic-space points
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let $F$ and $(G_i)_{i\in I}$ be presheaves of sets on the category of schemes over $S$, with test schemes and universes as in [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Let $f_i:G_i\to F$ be natural transformations. The family is jointly surjective on field-valued point classes if for every field $K$ [def-weil-field], every $s:\operatorname{Spec}K\to S$, and every $x\in F(\operatorname{Spec}K,s)$, there exist $i\in I$, a field $L$, a field embedding $e:K\to L$, and $y\in G_i(\operatorname{Spec}L,s\circ\operatorname{Spec}e)$ such that $f_i(y)=x|_L$. Here point classes identify representatives whose pullbacks to a common field extension agree. Thus this is exactly that the union of the images of $|f_i|$ is all of $|F|$: a source representative may be restricted to the common extension, and an extension lift conversely witnesses equality of point classes.
